messages.subject: Presentation by Dirk Eddelbuettel on "Programming with and Data:  Using and Extending R"
parts:
For those who don't read David Smith's blog on R,
http://blog.revolution-computing.com, (which I recommend) he mentioned
a presentation by Dirk Eddelbuettel to the Student Chapter of the ACM
(Association for Computing Machinery) at U. of Chicago last week.
Dirk has made his slides available at
http://dirk.eddelbuettel.com/papers/uofc_acm_feb2010.pdf

I think it is a great presentation. Dirk is an expert on high
performance computing using R and the use of R in the finance
industry. He is one of the organizers of the R/Finance conference
(www.rinfinance.com) in mid-April in Chicago. He will be presenting
his tutorial on "High Performance Computing with R" at this conference
and at the useR!2010 conference (www.user2010.org) in July.
